I have a good privilege of a great chairman and a former GP Thompson. I'm very happy that one of my old health colleagues is a ranking member. I hope the Senate Act Committee, Senator Bozen from Arkansas, and the relationships and the understandings that the Senator said and I developed with each other some years ago. We'll get to revisit all those. I'd like to say we're going to have fun, but the fact of the matter is, we're going to work really hard. And if we work hard enough, then we'll get a 23 farm bill and it will be a 23 farm bill that we'll provide a safety net that will help our producers get through. It can only be described as a crazy world we live in right now.
